intro: To connect Google Drive in ChatGPT on Mac, open Settings, go to Plugins, choose Google Drive, and click Connect. Then sign in to Google and tick every permission box, because one unticked box blocks the connection.
tldr: Open Settings, then Plugins, and choose Google Drive. Older builds call that section Apps.
Click Connect, sign in to Google, tick every permission box, and choose Select all.
Use the connection in a chat by typing @ and choosing Google Drive, or by using the + menu.
Plan settings and admin approval can block the connection, so check them before you troubleshoot.

blocks.text: Check your plan and account before you start

Plan access comes first, and the sources disagree about it. One third-party guide says Google Drive in Library on the web needs Plus or higher, depending on location and workspace settings. Another says the connector needs ChatGPT Pro, or a Business or Enterprise workspace where an admin turns it on. Neither guide is OpenAI's own page, so check your account directly.
Open Plugins and look for Google Drive. If it is missing, your plan or workspace may not include it. That answer comes faster than working through the setup steps and hitting an error.

Next, pick the right Google account. Use the account that owns the files you want ChatGPT to read. Work and personal accounts hold different files, so check which one you signed into before you approve anything.

If your files sit in a company workspace, the email addresses matter too. For admin-managed workspace sync, the ChatGPT email must match the Google Workspace email. A mismatch can stop the sync from working.
Your admin may also need to approve ChatGPT first. Ask before you start, not after you hit an error. Here is a quick check you can run in two minutes.

items: Your plan or workspace includes the Google Drive connector.
You know which Google account owns the files.
The ChatGPT email matches the Google Workspace email, if the files are work files.
You can approve Drive access yourself, or an admin can approve it for you.
The files you need sit in My Drive, not in a shared drive.

blocks.text: Where Google Drive lives in ChatGPT on Mac

The connector sits under Plugins. On chatgpt.com, the top bar has a Plugins link next to Settings and Help. The sidebar also lists Plugins, which is often the faster route once you know where to look.
Older builds still say Apps instead of Plugins. If you see Apps, open that section and look for Google Drive. The guides treat the two names as the same place.

The Mac menu bar is the gap. The guides name Settings and then Plugins, but none of them gives a verified Mac menu bar route. Look for Settings in the menu bar or the account menu first. Many Mac apps use ⌘, for Settings. This page could not confirm that shortcut for ChatGPT, so test it and see what happens.

blocks.title: Source gap
blocks.text: OpenAI's own help article could not be opened for this page. These steps come from third-party guides that cite OpenAI. If a name on your screen differs, trust your screen, then check the Help link at the top of chatgpt.com.
Grant permissions without the error

The consent screen causes most failed setups. Google shows several permission boxes for ChatGPT, and ChatGPT needs all of them. Leave one box unticked and you see ChatGPT needs all requested permissions or All permissions are required.
The fix is short. Choose Try again. Then tick everything and select Select all. If the error stays, reconnect from Plugins > Google Drive and start over.
Why does this matter? Partial access gives you partial answers. A gap in admin approval can leave ChatGPT able to read files but not change them.
Read the screen before you click. Confirm that the Google account name at the top is the one that owns your files.
Use Google Drive files in a chat

Once the connection works, you pull Drive files into a chat. Type @ and pick Google Drive from the list. You can also select + and choose it from the menu. The Lilach Bullock guide describes both routes.
Ask for one clear thing. The recovery advice for one specific error is to make one specific request, so that habit helps every time. Name the file and say what you need back.

Worked example. Say you keep a client list in a Google Sheet named Clients 2026. Start a new chat, type @, pick Google Drive, then ask: List every client in Clients 2026 with no email address. A good answer names the sheet and lists the rows. If the answer names a different file, ask again with the full file name.
After the first answer looks right, try a harder request, such as a total plus a short list. You learn more about the connector that way, and a harder test shows problems sooner.
Which Google Drive file types ChatGPT can read
The usecarly guide lists the file types that work with the connector. Check that your file is on this list before you spend time on it.

items: Google Docs
Google Sheets
Google Slides
PDF files
Word files (.docx)
Plain text files
CSV files
Excel files (.xlsx)
PowerPoint files

blocks.text: Test one file of each type you need before a project depends on it. A quick test costs less than a missed deadline.
The same guide says the June 2026 update to Drive actions has no version number. You cannot check a version to confirm you have it. Test the behavior instead.
ChatGPT's scale in 2026 and what it means for you

The connector belongs to a large product. OpenAI said ChatGPT reached 900 million weekly active users on Feb 27, 2026. That was up from 800 million reported in October 2025, a jump of 100 million. The same announcement put paying subscribers at 50 million.
Scale does not tell you whether your plan includes Google Drive. Check your own account for that, because the numbers describe the whole product, not your workspace.
Limits: what the Drive connector cannot do
The Drive AI guide lists several things the connector does not support. Read this list before you plan a project around Drive.

items: Shared drives in Library, so files in a shared drive may not appear
Changing files during deep research, which runs in read-only mode
Personal Drive sync for indexed search, which was retired
Undoing a set of changes as one action
Finding duplicate files
Moving files from Google Drive to Dropbox or OneDrive

blocks.text: Neither guide states a file count limit, a file size limit or a sync limit. Do not assume a number. Test with one of your largest files before a deadline.
Fix common Google Drive errors in ChatGPT on Mac
The Drive AI guide covers several error messages, and each one has a specific fix. Start with the exact message on your screen.

The message The Google_Drive tool has been disabled calls for a new chat. Start one, select Google Drive, and make one specific request. The guide cites community reports from September and October 2026. It says to contact support if the message keeps coming back.
Sync failed means the old personal sync is gone. ChatGPT retired personal Drive sync, and it cannot be reconnected. For workspace sync, check that the email addresses match.
A file in a shared drive may not show up. Copy it into My Drive, or ask an admin to add the shared drive to a workspace sync.
Admins and work accounts: where to check

Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces add a layer. Admins decide whether Drive actions run at all. The Drive AI guide says Drive actions are on by default on Business. On Enterprise and Edu, an admin must turn them on.

rows: Find Google Drive and select Connect
Admin Console > select the workspace > Plugins
Confirm Drive actions are on, since they are on by default
Workspace settings > Apps > Google Drive > Manage actions
Security > Access and data control > API controls
Approve the ChatGPT app's Drive access
blocks.caption: Where each role checks the Drive connector, using paths from third-party guides.

blocks.text: Admins who block access cause two visible results. One is a sign-in that fails. The other is a read-only result that cannot change files. If you see either, send your admin the exact error text. A ChatGPT admin can also turn the Drive action off for the workspace.
Disconnect or reconnect Google Drive
To disconnect, go to Settings > Plugins and choose the Google Drive entry. The Lilach Bullock guide gives that path for managing connected apps.
To reconnect after a failed permission step, go to Plugins > Google Drive and start again. Choose Try again, then Select all.
Reconnecting does not bring back retired personal Drive sync. It only restarts the connector for your account.
Mistakes people make with Google Drive in ChatGPT
These mistakes show up in the guides and in the error list above. Check each one before you file a support request.

items: Leaving one permission box unticked, then retrying the same screen without changing anything.
Asking for a file in a shared drive and expecting it to appear.
Trying to edit files during deep research, which is read-only.
Continuing an old chat after a Drive error instead of starting a new one.
Signing in with a personal Google account when the files live in a work workspace.
Expecting retired personal Drive sync to come back after a reconnect.

blocks.text: When something breaks, change one thing at a time. Check the account first, then the permissions, then the chat. That order keeps each test short and clear.
Where to go next
If some files live on your Mac instead of Drive, skip the connector. Attach them directly. The steps are in [how to attach a file in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/attach-a-file-in-chatgpt).
If you work on the same Drive files each week, a project keeps related chats together. See [how to create a project in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/create-a-project-in-chatgpt).
If you share a chat with a teammate after you pull Drive data into it, check the sharing steps in [how to share a chat in ChatGPT on Mac](/how-to/share-a-chat-in-chatgpt).

faq.question: Can I connect Google Drive in the ChatGPT Mac app, or only on the website?
faq.answer: The third-party guides describe one set of steps for both. They do not spell out differences between the Mac app and the web. Open Settings, then Plugins, in the app you use. If a name differs on your screen, trust what you see.

faq.question: Which ChatGPT plan do I need for Google Drive?
faq.answer: Sources disagree. One guide says Drive in Library on the web needs Plus or higher, depending on location and workspace settings. Another says Pro, or a Business or Enterprise workspace with the connector turned on. Check Plugins on your own account before you set up.

faq.question: Can ChatGPT change or delete my Google Drive files?
faq.answer: The sources describe changes to files, not deletion. ChatGPT can change files only when your permissions and admin settings allow it. During deep research, files are read-only. Test before you rely on it.

faq.question: Why can't ChatGPT find a file I can see in Google Drive?
faq.answer: The file may sit in a shared drive, and shared drives are not supported in Library. Copy the file into My Drive, then ask again. Use the full file name in your request.

faq.question: Can I reconnect my old personal Drive sync?
faq.answer: No. The Drive AI guide says personal Drive sync was retired and cannot be reconnected. You can still connect Google Drive through Plugins to use the live connector.

faq.question: How do I disconnect Google Drive from ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Go to Settings > Plugins and choose the Google Drive entry. The Lilach Bullock guide gives this path for managing connected apps.

faq.question: Does the connector work with Google Docs, Sheets and PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes. The usecarly guide lists Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and PDFs among the supported types. It also lists Word, text, CSV, XLSX and PowerPoint files.

requirements: A ChatGPT account on a plan that includes the Google Drive connector

steps.name: Open ChatGPT and sign in
steps.text: Open the ChatGPT app on your Mac and sign in. The same steps work on chatgpt.com, where the top bar has links to Settings and Plugins.
steps.tip: Use the account that has the plan you pay for, since the connector depends on plan settings.

steps.name: Open Settings
steps.text: Open Settings. In the Mac app, look for Settings in the menu bar or the account menu. This page could not confirm a Mac menu path, so check what your screen shows.
steps.tip: Many Mac apps use ⌘, for Settings. This is not confirmed for ChatGPT, so try the menus first.

steps.name: Open Plugins
steps.text: Choose Plugins in Settings. You can also click Plugins in the sidebar. Older builds call this section Apps.

steps.name: Choose Google Drive
steps.text: Find Google Drive in the list and open it. If you see Install plugin, select it first.
steps.tip: If Google Drive is missing, check your plan and workspace settings before you go further.

steps.name: Click Connect
steps.text: Select Connect. A Google sign-in page opens, where you choose the Google account that holds your files.

steps.name: Sign in to Google
steps.text: Sign in with that Google account. Confirm you are using the account that owns the files, not a similar one.

steps.name: Select all permissions
steps.text: On Google's permission screen, tick every box and choose Select all. Leaving one box unticked stops the connection.
steps.tip: If you see All permissions are required, choose Try again, then Select all.

steps.name: Use Google Drive in a chat
steps.text: Start a new chat. Type @ and pick Google Drive, or select + and choose it from the menu. Then ask for one specific file by name.
steps.tip: Starting a new chat is also the first fix for the tool disabled error.

steps.name: Check the answer
steps.text: Read the answer. It should name your file and summarize what is in it. If it names nothing, ask again with the full file name.
steps.tip: If the file sits in a shared drive, copy it into My Drive first.

troubleshooting.problem: ChatGPT needs all requested permissions, or All permissions are required
troubleshooting.fix: Choose Try again, then tick every box and select Select all on Google's screen. If it fails again, reconnect from Plugins > Google Drive.

troubleshooting.problem: The Google_Drive tool has been disabled
troubleshooting.fix: Start a new chat, select Google Drive, and make one specific request. If the message keeps coming back, contact OpenAI support.

troubleshooting.problem: Sync failed, or an old personal sync is missing
troubleshooting.fix: Personal Drive sync was retired and cannot be reconnected. For workspace sync, make sure the ChatGPT email matches the Google Workspace email.

troubleshooting.problem: A file in a shared drive cannot be found
troubleshooting.fix: Copy the file into My Drive, or ask an admin to include the shared drive in a workspace sync.

troubleshooting.problem: Sign-in is blocked, or files are read but not changed
troubleshooting.fix: A Google Workspace admin approves the app under Security > Access and data control > API controls. A ChatGPT admin can also turn the Drive action off, so ask whether it is on.

troubleshooting.problem: Google Drive does not appear in Plugins
troubleshooting.fix: Sources disagree on which plans include Drive. Check your plan. If your workspace is managed, ask an admin to enable Drive actions.
